title: Overhead Setup From Lob (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance heavy bongo bass guitar 136bpm pickleball training high energy English Spanish coach calls no slow sections
lyrics:
[Intro]
Lob goes up, sun in the sky
Read it early, position is why

[Verse 1]
Lob is hit, ball rises high
First move is back, read the arc and fly
Turn sideways, non-paddle shoulder points
Get behind the ball before it joints

Paddle up and back, continental position
Contact at full extension, that is the mission
Transfer weight forward into the contact zone
Overhead from the lob, take it home

[Pre-Chorus]
Read early, move back first
Sideways turn before the burst
Paddle up, shoulder points
Overhead setup, that is the joint

[Chorus]
Overhead setup from the lob, read it early
Move back first, sideways surely
Paddle up and contact high
Overhead from the lob, watch it fly

[Verse 2]
If the lob is deep and long, let it bounce
If it is short and sits up high, pounce
Never reach forward on the overhead
Let the ball come to you instead

[Bridge]
Bluey: The lob is up and she has moved back beautifully, overhead is on
Trevor: Early movement and sideways positioning are the two critical elements for overhead success
Michelle: Read it. Move back. Let it come. Extend.

[Chorus]
Overhead setup from the lob, read it early
Move back first, sideways surely
Paddle up and contact high
Overhead from the lob, watch it fly

[Outro]
Read early
Move back first
Overhead setup from the lob
